title: Gambit deployment diagram
description: How Gambit runs: one Cloudflare Worker with static assets, a Durable Object class and a D1 database. The browser runs the Godot WebAssembly export and, for games against the computer, Stockfish in a Web Worker. The Godot engine's .wasm is larger than Cloudflare's 25 MiB limit for a static file, so build.mjs splits it into index.wasm.0, .1, … and the Worker streams the parts back as one index.wasm.

nodes.name: Player's browser
nodes.description: Runs the Godot WebAssembly export (WebGL 2) and the page bridge.

nodes.name: Stockfish Web Worker
nodes.description: Stockfish 19 lite single-threaded WebAssembly, started on demand by bridge/engine.ts and spoken to in UCI.

nodes.name: Cloudflare edge
nodes.description: Runs the Worker on the route icelander.net/games/retro/chess* and serves static assets from ./dist.

nodes.name: chess Worker
nodes.description: worker/index.ts. Runs first for the page (sign-in), /games/retro/chess/api/*, /games/retro/chess/auth/* and /games/retro/chess/index.wasm; every other path is a static asset.

nodes.name: GameRoom Durable Objects
nodes.description: Binding ROOMS, class GameRoom (SQLite-backed, migration rooms-v1): one object per online game, named by the game's id. Hibernatable WebSockets to the two players.

nodes.name: D1 chess
nodes.description: Users (Gambit's own record of each player, keyed by address), challenges, games, game_events and contacts (worker/schema.sql).

nodes.name: Profile picture hosts
nodes.description: lh3.googleusercontent.com and avatars.githubusercontent.com, the only hosts api/avatar/{id} fetches from.
nodes.condition: A player with a profile picture

nodes.name: Resend
nodes.condition: RESEND_API_KEY and MAIL_FROM set; otherwise the inviter sends the link

nodes.name: icelander.net login service
nodes.description: accounts.icelander.net, in the icelander.net repository (accounts/): who holds the host's site_session cookie and their games: roles, asked on every request. The Worker reaches it only through a service binding.

artifacts.name: index.html, index.js, index.pck
artifacts.description: Godot's Web export (preset Web, release), with web_shell/shell.html as the page; tests/ and web_shell/ are left out of the pack.

artifacts.name: index.wasm.0, index.wasm.1
artifacts.description: The Godot engine's WebAssembly, cut into 20 MiB parts; the Worker joins them for /games/retro/chess/index.wasm.

artifacts.name: bridge.js
artifacts.description: esbuild bundle of bridge/main.ts and bridge/engine.ts, minified; run in the page.

artifacts.name: engine/stockfish.js, stockfish.wasm, COPYING.txt
artifacts.description: Copied from the stockfish npm package; loaded into the Stockfish Web Worker.

artifacts.name: _headers, shell.css, favicon.svg
artifacts.description: The Content-Security-Policy and other headers, the loading screen's styles and the icon.

artifacts.name: Worker script
artifacts.description: The fetch handler with auth, the API and shared/, bundled by wrangler.

artifacts.name: GameRoom class
artifacts.description: Exported from the Worker script and bound as ROOMS.

artifacts.name: schema.sql
artifacts.description: Applied by hand with wrangler d1 execute; every statement can run again.

relationships.description: HTTPS: the page, its assets, the joined index.wasm, auth/ and api/; a WebSocket to api/games/{id}/live during an online game.
ROOMS.idFromName(game id): POST /action and the /live WebSocket upgrade, with X-User and X-Game headers.
D1 binding DB: loads and saves the game it guards.
HTTPS fetch for api/avatar/{id}, cached for a day.
Service binding ACCOUNTS (entrypoint Internal): the game's page and its API need a signed-in player.
